case.message: Compare Apple annual revenue and net income before and after November 10, 2023. Explain whether management outlook passages can actually be tested using the retrieved financial metrics.

data.response:
# Apple Annual Revenue and Net Income Investigation

**Insufficient evidence**

AAPL revenue for the fiscal period ended 2024-09-28 was $391.035 billion [Eda15bd495b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html), up from $383.285 billion for 2023-09-30 [E0aa1788ab7](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html). AAPL net income for the fiscal period ended 2024-09-28 was $93.736 billion [E6cd34a6787](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html), down from $96.995 billion for 2023-09-30 [Eb7b848fc7d](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html). AAPL cash PP&E purchases for the fiscal period ended 2024-09-28 was $9.447 billion [E572b690252](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html), down from $10.959 billion for 2023-09-30 [E3c9ad1784b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html).

## What was knowable then

As of November 10, 2023, Apple had filed its annual financial data for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2023, reporting revenue of $383,285,000,000 and net income of $96,995,000,000 [Eef37380841](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html) [E07e95d6769](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html). For the prior fiscal year ended September 24, 2022, known figures were revenue of $394,328,000,000 and net income of $99,803,000,000 [Ef83db0dff2](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019322000108/0000320193-22-000108-index.html) [E64da7ae5c1](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019322000108/0000320193-22-000108-index.html). No management outlook records were retrieved from the date-bounded source within this timeframe [E6821590ed0].

## What happened later

In subsequent filings through March 1, 2025, Apple reported annual figures for the fiscal year ended September 28, 2024, showing revenue of $391,035,000,000 and net income of $93,736,000,000 [Eda15bd495b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html) [E6cd34a6787](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html). Retrospective price series from Yahoo Finance and revised FRED macro series were placed in hindsight context [Ee2b983160f](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/FEDFUNDS) [E19e1a6b6ff](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/CPIAUCSL) [E0e382ed2e2](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/AAPL/history/).

## The peer test

Only AAPL was selected. Add a peer company to compare results.

## Cross-examination

Management outlook passages cannot be tested because no relevant management outlook claims or forecasts were retrieved as of November 10, 2023 [E6821590ed0]. Without retrieved management passages, any evaluation of forward-looking statements remains unsupported by empirical evidence.

## Limits

- No management outlook claims were retrieved under the supported tags or search as of November 10, 2023, making it impossible to empirically test management outlook passages against retrieved metrics.
